title: Hoagy Carmichael plays Washboard Blues in Indianapolis
summary: In the early hours Whiteman and Jimmy Dorsey brought Hoagy to Challis's room; he arranged Washboard Blues around Hoagy's singing.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: We come down to Indianapolis, maybe some time in October. There's a knock on my door about 2 o'clock one morning and in comes three guys, Jimmy, Paul and Hoagy and you know, they had been drinking, enjoying each other's company; but they weren't stewed or anything like that. They came in, you could tell they were having a good time, and Paul says, 'this guy's got a number and I want you to hear it. I want him to play it

for you. I want you to hear it and make it up for us. So get out the organ, " you know, so we get out the organ and Hoagy sits down and plays "Washboard Blues," and he sings most of it, you know, the way he sings --

Not only that, he tries to sing a little bit out of tune and then come back on key, so he went over the whole thing. I liked it very much and said, "I could do that." And they stayed there a little while. I didn't have anything more to drink for them, so Hoagy said he was going to come along with the band for a little while and we could work together, and I said, "Good." There really wasn't much that he could do, because he sang so much of it.

But I had to figure out something to put behind and the [fiddles,] what to do with, so he comes along two or three times and in the meantime some of the guys in the band go over with him, he had come around and Jimmy and Tommy would come over, and they made this "One Night in HANAMA the Band," I think, over there for Gennett. Jenette.

A little outside of the place, so anyway I worked with Hoag and he sits down and sings it over three times and then I figure I got to get a combination on it, to put behind it. I didn't want to put the whole band in it, so I got something down there, you know, no cello or

anything, I got the bass clarinet, and all the clarinets and strings and Matty doubled on the viola, he had a viola he liked to play, so Hoagy plays the thing over and sings it and I put down the accompaniment pretty much the way he plays it, fills it out a little bit.
